A.notes: A has a clear cinematic idea: oversized title-card typography under a moving spotlight, and that signature carries from hero to project chapters and CTA. The scroll frames show purposeful progression with the light and chapter reveals, though I cannot judge timing from stills and the mobile compositions feel less controlled, with some sections reading overly sparse or awkwardly cropped.

B.notes: B is the stronger type-led concept: the editorial serif hook, chapter numbering, and abstract title-sequence shapes all support one coherent idea about opening titles. Craft and typography are excellent across desktop and mobile, while the scroll-strip motion looks competent but mostly sectional and reveal-based rather than clearly story-driving from frames alone.

raw.why: B answers the brief more completely with a more distinctive type-led chapter concept and higher overall craft, even though A shows slightly stronger motion in the frame strip.
